audience: clinician knowledge only; patient text must not inherit these numerical fields

keynote522.population: Previously untreated non-metastatic TNBC: T1c N1-2 or T2-4 N0-2; ECOG 0-1 in original trial.
keynote522.design: Randomised double-blind phase III; 2:1 allocation; PD-L1 expression was not an entry selection requirement.
keynote522.experimental_arm: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy, followed after surgery by pembrolizumab
keynote522.comparator_arm: Neoadjuvant placebo plus the same chemotherapy, followed after surgery by placebo
keynote522.trial_schedule: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks; weekly paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 plus carboplatin AUC5 every 3 weeks or AUC1.5 weekly for 12 weeks; then four 3-weekly AC/EC cycles; surgery; nine 3-weekly pembrolizumab/placebo doses.

endpoint_definitions.pCR: ypT0/Tis ypN0: no residual invasive cancer in breast or sampled regional nodes; in-situ disease permitted by this definition.
endpoint_definitions.EFS: From randomisation to progression preventing definitive surgery, local or distant recurrence, second primary cancer, or death from any cause.
endpoint_definitions.OS: Time from randomisation to death from any cause.

schedule_applicability.00857: Same trial-tested 200 mg q3w pembrolizumab and q3w carboplatin AUC5/AC approach; exact NCCP eligibility and support remain separate.
schedule_applicability.00858: Same trial-tested 200 mg q3w pembrolizumab and weekly carboplatin AUC1.5/3-weekly AC approach; trial did not randomise the carboplatin schedules against each other.
schedule_applicability.00860: NCCP q6w pembrolizumab and dose-dense AC variant. KEYNOTE-522 supports the treatment strategy but did not directly test this exact combined timing.
schedule_applicability.00861: NCCP q6w pembrolizumab and dose-dense AC variant with weekly carboplatin. Do not describe exact schedule survival equivalence as demonstrated by KEYNOTE-522.

analyses.analysis: First planned interim analysis; pCR in first 602 randomised patients, not all 1174
analyses.note: Historical pCR result; do not attach the full ITT denominator or represent this as a survival endpoint.

analyses.analysis: Fourth planned interim analysis; confirmatory EFS analysis
Prespecified final formal OS hypothesis test; updated EFS descriptive

endpoints.hr_note: Non-proportional hazards: report provides piecewise estimates and weighted average HR0.66. Do not auto-fill a conventional proportional-hazards CI from secondary summaries.

analyses.source_locations: Abstract; Figure1B p5 for OS absolute difference CI; p6 text for nonproportional hazards and EFS; Figure2 p7.

analyses.evidence_format: Conference abstract reporting final follow-up; not a full new peer-reviewed efficacy report
analyses.analysis_status: Descriptive follow-up of previously demonstrated EFS/OS benefits; no new formal OS hypothesis test implied
analyses.note: Do not mix these 7-year rates with 2024 or2022 HRs, cutoffs, follow-up or confidence intervals.

calgb40603.design: 2x2 randomised phaseII factorial; stageII-III TNBC; four arms with or without carboplatin and bevacizumab
calgb40603.schedule: Paclitaxel80 mg/m2 weekly x12, carboplatinAUC6 q3w x4 where assigned; then ddAC q2w x4

initial_report.pcr_definition: ypT0/is N0 (breast and axilla); secondary endpoint
initial_report.location: Figure3B and Table2 p5; pooled factorial contrast, not carboplatin-only arm versus pure control

longterm_report.interpretation: No statistically demonstrated EFS or OS improvement with carboplatin; trial not powered for long-term outcomes. Absence of statistical significance is not proof of no benefit.

calgb40603.applicability: 00348 matches the q3wAUC6/planned ddAC backbone;00734 weeklyAUC2 is not the tested CALGB schedule.
calgb40603.safety_summary: More haematological toxicity and missed/reduced doses with carboplatin.

brightness.schedule: Weekly paclitaxel x12 with q3wcarboplatin where allocated, then AC q2-3w x4
brightness.analysis_status: Post hoc carboplatin contrast; secondary analyses descriptive because a co-primary comparison was not met
brightness.os: No statistically significant difference between arms
brightness.absolute_difference: Do not populate from the abstract: matching fixed-time arm rates not provided there.
brightness.applicability: Supportive platinum evidence, not direct proof of superiority for00734weeklyAUC2 schedule.

geparsixto.applicability: Different backbone: weekly paclitaxel and nonpegylated liposomal doxorubicin for18weeks, with bevacizumab inTNBC; carboplatin weekly AUC2 reduced to1.5 by amendment. Not00734's paclitaxel/carbo followed by ddAC.
geparsixto.display_recommendation: Contextual citation only; do not import its DFS rates or response rates as exact00734 outcomes.

guardrails: Treat trial results as results of the whole tested perioperative strategy, not an independently measured contribution from each phase or drug.
Treatment line is initial perioperative systemic therapy of previously untreated nonmetastatic disease; avoid metastatic first-line labels.
Do not compare different trials as a drug ranking or convert absolute percentage-point differences into personalised extra lifespan.
The first602 pCR cohort and full1174 survival cohort are not interchangeable.
No survival statistics, HRs or comparative response rates in patient interfaces or generated patient material.
Separate study-report maturity from the fact that a formal endpoint benefit had previously been established.
